mobile_voice_announce_background: Atlas went to the background, so the microphone is off. Insert or discard what you said.
mobile_voice_announce_cap: Five-minute limit reached. The microphone is off. Insert or discard what you said.
mobile_voice_downloading_body: The on-device language pack is still downloading. Try again in a moment, or use the system recognizer, which may send your audio to Apple or Google.
mobile_voice_error_busy: The microphone is in use by another app.
mobile_voice_error_interrupted: Dictation was interrupted, for example by a call. Start it again.
mobile_voice_error_language: This language is not available for dictation on this phone.
mobile_voice_error_permission: Atlas lost access to the microphone. Turn it on in Settings.
mobile_voice_none_body: This phone has no speech recognizer at all. Type your message instead.
mobile_voice_nothing_heard: Nothing was recognised. Try again closer to the microphone.
mobile_voice_online_warning: May send audio to Apple or Google
mobile_voice_perm_mic_off_hint: Turn on Microphone for Atlas in Settings.
mobile_voice_perm_mic_private: Speech is recognised on this phone. Audio is never recorded, saved or sent to your computer.
mobile_voice_perm_mic_restricted: A setting on this phone (like Screen Time) stops apps from using the microphone.
mobile_voice_perm_mic_why: Atlas turns what you say into text for your message to a crewmate.
mobile_voice_perm_speech_off_hint: Turn on Speech Recognition for Atlas in Settings.
mobile_voice_perm_speech_private: Atlas asks iOS to recognise speech on this iPhone. Only if you choose the online system recognizer can audio go to Apple.
mobile_voice_perm_speech_restricted: A setting on this phone stops apps from using speech recognition.
mobile_voice_perm_speech_why: iOS needs your permission to turn what you say into text for your message to a crewmate.
mobile_voice_unsupported_body: This phone cannot recognise your language without sending audio away. The system recognizer can, but it may send your audio to Apple or Google.
mobile_voice_unsupported_title: Dictation is not available on this phone
